name: com.pdfgate/mcp-server
description: MCP server for the PDFGate API. Generate PDFs, manage documents and handle e-signatures.

environmentVariables.name: PDFGATE_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Your PDFGate API key (starts with live_ for production or test_ for sandbox)

environmentVariables.name: PDFGATE_WEBHOOK_PORT
environmentVariables.description: Port for the local webhook listener (default: 3599)

headers.name: X-API-KEY
headers.description: Your PDFGate API key (live_ for production, test_ for sandbox). Optional: omit to authenticate with OAuth instead.
